model_output.verdict: A distribution supervisor who grew from picking into leading a 35-person night shift.
write_up: A recruiter can follow your progression from Order Picker to Shift Supervisor and see what your night shift handles. The first question is how much order volume you schedule for and what changed under your supervision.

The line about supervising 35 associates across picking, packing, and loading works well: it names your team and the work they do. Use it as a model, then add your part in the scanner rollout and more detail about training new leads.

cards.line: - Supervise a night shift of 35 associates across picking, packing, and loading
cards.cannot_tell: Keep this line. It gives a recruiter a concrete picture of the operation you supervise without making them guess.

cards.line: - Schedule labor and assign zones based on daily order volume
cards.cannot_tell: A recruiter can see how you make assignments, but not how much order volume you plan around. That would give the scheduling work more context.
cards.example: Schedule labor and assign zones based on daily order volume of [number] orders
cards.question: What daily order volume do you typically schedule labor around?

cards.line: - Train new leads on the warehouse management system
cards.cannot_tell: Training new leads is useful to know about. How many have you trained, and what do you teach them to do in the system?
cards.example: Train [number] new leads on [training topics] in the warehouse management system
cards.question: How many new leads have you trained, and what did you teach them in the system?

cards.line: - Helped roll out handheld scanners on the pick floor
cards.cannot_tell: The scanner rollout is a concrete project, but a recruiter can't tell what part you handled. Keep the credit at the level you had and name your contribution.
cards.example: Helped roll out handheld scanners on the pick floor by [your contribution]
cards.question: What did you do to help roll out the scanners?

fit.note: Your experience points toward distribution and outbound shift supervision. The progression at Sierra Freight Distribution and the 35-associate night shift make that direction easy to follow.
